verdict.rationale: The Swift SDK documents native tool calling: you register tools, and the SDK runs the call-and-execute loop and detects the model's expected tool format. Nothing in the pack covers reasoning-parser support, or tools and reasoning fields on the OpenAI-compatible hosted request API. missing for 10: reasoning-parser support, tool-calling parameters documented on the hosted /v1 chat completion requests, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: Register a tool and the function that runs it. The SDK owns the call-and-execute loop and detects the format the model expects.
